Interface OrderCardRenderer

All Known Implementing Classes:
CurrentOrderRenderer, FinishedOrderRenderer, IncomingOrderRenderer
public interface OrderCardRenderer
Defines how an OrderCurrent is visually rendered into a JavaFX VBox container.

Implementations are responsible for presenting different order states (incoming, current, finished) in the UI.
